messages.en:
{07 14 00}When I pick up a pretty
shell like a conch, {07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I don't
sell it right away.
Instead, {01 00 00 05 00}I like to use it to
decorate my house for a
little bit.
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I think being able to hear
the ocean in my home is
wonderful, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui ma korjan ilusa karbi
nagu tritoonikarp, {07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}ei müü
ma seda kohe ära.
Selle asemel {01 00 00 05 00}kaunistan
sellega mõnda aega oma
maja.
{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Minu arust on imeline
kuulda kodus
ookeani, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}It's not that I hate the
